player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered the Home office and immediately chose to go back to the Craft room, which I had already visited, and then finished the game without checking if other unvisited rooms (like the Gallery or Laundry room) were reachable from the current path. I did not maintain a mental map of visited rooms to avoid loops or dead ends. Next time, I will keep a running list of visited rooms. When in the Home office, instead of going back to Craft, I will check if there are any unvisited neighbors. If none exist, I will backtrack to a previously visited room that leads to unexplored areas (like the Gallery) rather than stopping prematurely. I will only say DONE when I am in a room with no unvisited neighbors and have visited all reachable rooms.
